stages.compare_to: paper_results.json datasets.blender-fewview{6,12}.method; delta = stage2 - stage1 vs paper SplatFields3D - 3DGS

notes: No shared gsplat baseline exists for Blender few-view; the paper's own 3DGS row is reproduced by stage 1 (splatfields-3dgs), which also produces the SplatFields init cloud. --steps must be 40000 (bake step). Primary target 6 views (paper headline +1.64 dB mean); 12 views optional if GPU time is short. Paper reports no Mip-NeRF 360 / T&T / DB / LLFF numbers.
